items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: they had the recreation band with Cliff Curry. They had Pete Bacopa... The Bacopa was in there

ctx.x: Well, some, but I mean he did a lot of reading most of them. He was really good. He got a good tone out of his violin. Oh, so many of them. I mean they had the symphony, they had the military bands, they had the dance band, and they had the recreation band with Cliff Curry. They had Pete Bacopa, he had a little outfit.
That's all that he had? Yeah.
